name: @cas/flow
description: Conformal-transplant flow kernel shared by the split-out 2D Electrostatics, Hele-Shaw Flow, and Potential Theory apps (ADR-0036). The closed-form reference flows past/inside the unit disk (uniform + circulation; boundary source–sink ports) and the flow-net level curves built by inverting the reference potential (transplant.ts); the Schwarz–Christoffel glue that carries those nets onto a bounded polygon's exterior/interior via @cas/conformal (polygonMap.ts); the counter-clockwise polygon presets (transplantPresets.ts); and a small 2D-canvas line-art drawer for the transplant panes (net2d.ts). Strict TypeScript on @cas/conformal. Convention-neutral (ADR-0006). Consumed via SOURCE by the suite's Vite/Vitest bundlers (no dist build).
author: Andrew Graven <andrew@graven.com>
